commands.label: install-claude-colors-v2
commands.note: Install updated claude_field_colors_v2.user.js into Tampermonkey scripts folder. Fixes field borders + Claude icon visibility under black-green-2 theme.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$src='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EndoScorpion/signal/relay/relay/claude_field_colors_v2.user.js'; $dst='C:\Users\endos\AppData\Roaming\Tampermonkey\scripts'; if(-not (Test-Path $dst)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dst | Out-Null}; Invoke-WebRequest $src -OutFile (Join-Path $dst 'claude_field_colors_v2.user.js') -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-022';label='install-claude-colors-v2';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ')}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $p"
